ice_psd_and_cap.public_ni_basis: number per kg dry air; the KDM6 wrapper multiplies by dry density at input and divides by dry density at output
ice_psd_and_cap.pidni: pi*500 for d=3, mu=0 generalized-gamma mass coefficient
ice_psd_and_cap.entry_cap_source_location: actual source line 1564; upstream line 762 includes the comment that the bound prevents very large ice number from homogeneous droplet freezing
ice_psd_and_cap.pre_reconstruction_consumers: After entry clamp, den_tmp is set to dry_carrier_density (line 1615); slope_kdm6 computes a clamped lambda and number fall speed without rewriting nci, then kdm6_velocity_rates and the first ice sedimentation updates use the capped nci (lines 1815-2029).
ice_psd_and_cap.projection_equation: if derived lambda is at/below 9080, clamp lambda to 9080 and set NI=dry_density*QI*lambda^3/pidni
ice_psd_and_cap.lambda_min_is_mass_ceiling: It is a source PSD slope clamp and implies a maximum representable mean particle mass within that PSD branch, but it is not an independent QI rejection condition.
ice_psd_and_cap.conclusion: The joint lambda interval plus entry NI cap is a selected PR83 prior domain. The actual KDM6 consumer clips incoming NI then restores the lambda endpoint from QI, allowing post-projection NI above 1e6; this PR83 rejection does not establish native rejection of those QI masses.

first_process_order_implication.finding: Entry-clipped NI is used by ice number fall/sedimentation before the first mass-based PSD normalization at lines 2307-2318.
first_process_order_implication.source_compatible_entry_floor_candidate: max(1e6, smallest REAL32 public NI roundtrip that satisfies REAL64 public PSD minimum and upward-rounded REAL32 internal source floor)
first_process_order_implication.interpretation: The implemented guard clips only incoming internal NI to max(1e6, minimal source-PSD-valid public REAL32 NI multiplied by source dry density). This preserves the low-IWC homogeneous-freezing guard while preventing high-IWC source-valid NI from being clipped before sedimentation. It changes no QI, temperature, class, slope endpoint, or process rate.
constraints: Use the source REAL32 arithmetic/order and verify finite/range before use.
Do not alter QI, temperature, or hydrometeor class.
Validate against the exact first slope calculation and later lambda reconstruction.
This is source compatibility, not observation-backed initialization or scientific prior evidence.

process_rate.name: psaut
process_rate.qi0: Piecewise temperature/supcol expression with branch T=255.66 K; implementation multiplies the expression by gas_density
process_rate.mass_ledger: QI decreases by psaut*dt; QSNOW increases by psaut*dt
process_rate.number_ledger: NI decreases by nsaut*dt; no prognostic snow number receives a number transfer
process_rate.enthalpy: Final temperature expression excludes psaut; transfer is solid ice to solid snow and does not change temperature in this source branch
process_rate.initialization_reuse: Not a static mass threshold. It is a time-dependent tendency subject to thermal, PSD, dt, and coupled-rate constraints.

size_conversion.predicate: QI>=qmin, T<273.15 K, diagnosed avedia>=200e-6 m
size_conversion.ledger: All QI transfers to QSNOW; QI and NI set to zero; no snow number or temperature change
size_conversion.reachability_status: Algebraic source-based inference only; no runtime call was run.

other_ice_collectors.praci: Rain collection of ice; mass is partitioned to snow/graupel through delta3, and ice number is sunk
other_ice_collectors.initialization_reuse: Collection tendencies require existing collector states and rates; not unconditional initial redistributions.

v2_choices.choice: Use max(1e6, R32(QN_min*rho)) as the internal entry ceiling. QN_min is the smallest REAL32 public number satisfying both the REAL64 source PSD minimum and R32(QN_min*rho) >= ceil_R32(rho64*public_min64). The source helper uses bounded NEAREST searches and fail-closes on invalid/range conditions.
v2_choices.tradeoff: Smallest source-aligned adjustment identified; changes only NI. It requires source-level implementation/review and is not evidence that the selected NI prior is physically observed.

v2_choices.choice: Represent affected ice with the source lambda endpoint and validate the source-equivalent post-projection state, allowing internal NI above 1e6 after the single entry clamp.
v2_choices.tradeoff: Matches actual source moment projection and preserves QI; requires explicit change to PR83's cap-intersection prior contract, but leaves first-sedimentation NI clipping unless source order is changed.

v2_choices.choice: Retain PR83 joint lambda/cap admission and reject the transaction.
v2_choices.tradeoff: Keeps the declared research prior unchanged; label failure as prior-domain infeasibility rather than native KDM6 rejection.

v2_choices.choice: Only consider QI-to-QSNOW transfer under independently justified physics and conservation criteria.
v2_choices.tradeoff: The 200um criterion is unreachable under the configured lambda bound; psaut is a tendency and cannot be converted into excess-cap transfer without an additional time/state/energy policy.
